msContents.summary: This manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya was microfilmed as part of the NGMPP project. The catalogue describes it as complete.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.rubric: oṁ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya narañ caiva narottamam | devīṃ sarasvatīñ caiva tato jayam udīrayet ||
msItem.colophon:
|| śubham astu || śrīr astu ||
la saṃ 416 āṣāḍha vadi 13 budhe parihālagrāme sasaduśrīmaṇḍanaśarmmaṇena likhitam idaṃ pustakam || ||
rāma rāma mahābāho devānām abhayaṅkara | tvāṃ namamy eha deveśa mama nasyatu pātakam || oṁ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya ||

handNote.desc: The NGCMP describes this as Maithili script. The title card notes that marginal notes are written in red.

origin.origDate: The colophon gives the year LS 416, although this may have been copied from its exemplar.

acquisition.p: Held at the National Archives, Kathmandu, Nepal.

encodingDesc.p: IAST transliteration. ẏa for ya with nukta. t__ for final -t.

lg.l: kathayantaṃ hibhītāthānāṃ prabhāvanedbhūvānadbhutāṃs tathā ||
lomasaṃ dharmmatattvajñaṃ paryapṛchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
yo rakṣet__ prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhaẏārttaṃ śaraṇād gatam |

tasya pu
ṇyaphalaṃ yat__ syāt tan me brūhi tapodhanaḥ ||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvve samāptasamagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |

ekato bhaẏabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prā
ṇarakṣaṇam |
idam eva purā devās tulāẏāṃ samatolaẏan |
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate ||

atraivādyaharantīmam itihāsaṃ purā
tanaṃ |
indrasyāgneś ca samvādaṃ śiver auśaneśīnarasya ca |
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpam |

indraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto
gnir bbhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ |
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhaẏāt |

śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nilīno dvihaledbhi
ẏātbhayavihvalaḥ |
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā ||

dharmmā
tmānaṃ tvām ihāhahur ekaṃ rājan_ mahīkṣitam |
sarvvadharmmaviruddhaṃ hi katham etat__ kariṣyasi |
bhavān_ kadayaṃkṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinam |
ṣkakṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet |
nopakārapare py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare pi tvam upakaraparo yathā |
ahite hitabuddhis taṃs tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt__ |
doṣāntenveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ |

tad eṣa vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamā
nasya me kṣudhā |
taṃ rajyan_ dharmmalobhena dharmmam utsṛṣṭamāvān asim ||

saṃtrastarupas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto
vihaṅgamaḥ |
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛṣurayaṃ khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasyābhayārthinaḥ |

katham asmadvidhaḥ
kuryāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vvigarhitaḥ |
lobhāt__ dveṣād bhaẏād vāpi yastyajet__ śaraṇāgatam |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhuhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

śāstreṣu
niparihāraḥṣkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahantrīṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit__ |
yathātmanaḥ priẏāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhaẏatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāśokair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |

jantavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyos tra
syanti te tataḥ |
yannimittaṃ bhavechokas trāso vā krodha eva vā |
āyāso vā ẏato mūlam ekāṅgataṅgam api taṃ tyajet |

marttavyam iti ya
d duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāẏate |
yuktas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitatum |

yathā hi te jīvitam ātmaneaḥ priẏaṃ tathā pare
ṣām api jīvitaṃ priẏam |
saṃrakṣyate jīvitam ātmāno yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jījīvitam |
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppaẏiṣye kapotakam |
yad atra manyase yuktaṃ vaktukarttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada ||
āhārāḥ sarvvabhūtāni sambhavanti janeśvara |

āhāreṇa vivardhante tena jīvanti
caiva hi |
na śakyate vinā tena ciraṃ prāṇair jjijīvitatum |
śakyate rthair vināpy anyai rājan_ varttaẏituṃ ciram |

na tv āhāravihīnena śa
kyaṃ varttaẏituṃ ciram |
bhakṣād vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viśāmpate |
vihāẏa kāẏaṃ yāsyanti pantānam apunarbbhavam |

mṛte ca
maẏi sarvvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati |
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān na rakṣasi |
dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharma naiṣa dharmaḥ parantapa ||

avirodhī
taẏor yat__ syāt__ sa dharmmaḥ sadbhir iṣyate |
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya vicintya gurulāghavam |
yataḥ śreẏas tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇṇayaṃ ||
nāto bhūẏaḥ paro dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecaraḥ |
prāṇināṃ bhaẏabhītānām abhaẏaṃ yat__ pradīẏate |

varam ekasya satvasya dattvādyubhaẏadakṣi
ṇām |
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ sakāścanam |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti daẏāparaḥ |

tasya dehād vimuktasya bhaẏaṃ nāsti ku
taścana |
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |
durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtābhaẏapradaḥ |

mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣī
ẏate phalam |
bhītābhaẏapradānasya kṣaẏa eva na vidyate |
dattam iṣṭaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ tīthasevā śrutaṃ tathā |

sarvvāṇy abhaẏadānasya kalāṃ nārgharhanti ṣo
ḍaśīm |
catuḥsāgaraparyāntāṃ yo dadyāt__ pṛthivīm imām |
sattvetvebhyo 'bhayado yaś ca taẏor abhaẏado dhikaḥ |
api tyaje rāṣṭram ahaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajam |
nānnitv imaṃ bhaẏasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnakapotakam |
bhaveẏam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇināṃ sārttināśanaḥ |
na hy ahaṃ kamaẏe rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbbhavam |

prāṇināṃ bhaẏa
bhītānāṃ kāmaye bhaẏanāśanam |
yathā taca nānṛtā vāṇāṇī maẏeṣaṃ samudāhṛtā |
satyenānena bhagavān_ prīẏatāṃ parameśvaraḥ |

āhāro tv e
samārambhāas tava sarvvecāyaṃ vihaṅgamaḥ |
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāraṃ manojñaṃ vai dadāmy aham ||

ẏa eṣa vihito smātokam āhāras tu kapo
takaḥ |
tam evotsṛjya cāhāraiḥ kāryam asya parair mmama |
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādanti śrutir eṣā purātanī |

mā rājan_ sāram ajñāẏā kadalī
skandham āruha ||
nāhaṃ namucchāstrakuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgamam |
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo ẏaṃ dharmmaḥ sattvadaẏāparaḥ |

sarvvasattveṣu ya
d dānam ekasattve ca yā daẏā |
sarvvasattvapradānād dhi daẏaikāsmin_ viśiṣyate |
sarvve vedā na tat__ kuyuḥ sarvve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca
yat__ kuryāt__ prāṇināṃ daẏā |
vāṅmanaḥkarmmabhir ye tu sarvvasattvahite ratāḥ |
daẏādārśitapantāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |

gachatas tiṣṭhato vāpi
jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā |
yan na bhūtahitāthāẏa tat__ paśor iva ceṣṭitam |
jaṅgamādīni bhūtāni stāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |

ātmavat__ pari
rakṣanti te yānti paramāṅ gatim |
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānan tu yaḥ śatruḥ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram idam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

rājyaṃ
śivīnāṃ sumahat__ prayachāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmaẏase hy anyad varjjaẏitvā vihaṅgamam ||

yadi rājan_ kapoto smin_ sudṛḍhā prī
tir īdṛśī |
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni praẏaccha me ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |

tāvat te haṃ praẏachāmi
svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi |
yat tan manogataṃ mahyaṃ tvaẏā duḥkhanabhāṣitam |
mamāẏaṃ priẏam evaitat__ kasmāt te vihitaṃ cirāt__ |

adhruveṇa śarī
reṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjjaẏed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhcetanaḥ |
yadi prāṇyupakārāẏa deho ẏaṃ nopasadyate |

tataḥ
kim upakāro sya pratyahaṃ kṛkriẏate vṛthā ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tavarava māṃsaṃ janeśvara |

tasmāt__ kalpanadhṛtaṃ praẏaccha tu
laẏām api bhṛśaṃ ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ vā syād yad vā tava vihaṅgama ||
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭas tulaẏāmāṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ |
tyaktvātmasukhabhogecchāṃ sarvvasattvahitaiṣiṇaḥ |

bhavanti pa
raduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ |
vaẏasapiṇas tulaẏādhriyamānam tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt__ sa pārthivaḥ |
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena savatemaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svaẏam |
paraduḥkhātulyarā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
nāpekṣante mahātmānaḥ svaduḥkhāni mahātmanty api |
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīṇare nṛpe |

devadundubhaẏo neduḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papā
ta ca |
tatas tasya tadā chuddhiṃ jñātvā dharmme stirāṃ śubhām |
śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāẏāa vākyeam etad abhāṣata ||

indro ham asmi bhadran te ka
poto ẏaṅ gatāśanaḥ |
jijñāsamānau rājan_ tvām imaṃ yajñam apāgatau |
naitat__ pūrvve nṛpāś cakruḥ kariṣyanti na cāpare |

mahākāruṇikenedaṃ yat__ kṛ
taṃ duḥkaraṃ tvaẏā |
parāthe tyajataḥ prāṇān_ yā pratir abhavatut tava |
prāṇasaṃśaẏalubdheṣu na sā prāṇiṣu dehinām |

parān naikātharthaikāntakalyāṇī sva
ẏam ekāsvāśrayatyantaniṣṭhurā |
tvaẏ evea kevalā rājan_ karuṇā taruṇāẏate |
svakarmmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair bbaddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat |

tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣā
thaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇam eva ca |
tathā sarvvāṃs te gatārvvātmanā vāpi doṣeṣu prakṛtaṃ tvayā |
anāthe vikaṇele bhīte nirddhane rthini rogiṇi |

adṛṣṭe dṛṣṭapūrvve ca
vāle ca karuṇo tava |
paropakārajanmāno vidhātā vitās traẏaḥvihitā traye |
sajalā jaladās tv arthaṃ saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ |

yathaiṣām ātmasantāneyathā vai vātmanaḥ sthāne vāsanāpi na
vidyate |
akṛtyetverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca |
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ |

l.del: tathā sarvvātmanā cāpi tvayā doṣāḥ parājitāḥ |

lg.l:
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇā
n_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa jāti paramaṃ stānaṃ parād api hitāt__ param |
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣo sadā |

sa padaṃ tad avā
pnoti parād api ca yat__ param |
paropakāraikadheẏaḥ svasukhāẏa gataspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāẏante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi |

yat__ sva
māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pāthiva |
eṣā te śāśvatī vītikīrttiktor llokān anugāmiṣyati |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālaẏitvā ciraṃ mahīm |

sarvvaloka
m atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayam |
rājā tupi kratum iṣṭvā taṃ mumude devavac ciraṃ |
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamam |
sa vidhūẏeha pāpāni praẏāti paramāṃ gatim |

vicintya rāja svaśarīram uttamamaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvvaja
nasya durllabham |
śarīradānāt__ parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāẏa lokatraẏabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau ||
